user_review.method: Maintainer review of actual paired research outputs and source anchors, executed comparator tests, and a fresh-agent natural-entry test on a synthetic local fixture. Private inputs and raw usage receipts remain outside the public package. The paired baseline reconstructs ordinary full-index review rather than claiming to reproduce a historical agent trace.

scenarios.request: Review a historical saved-library increment through full-index and delta-first paths with the same research output.
scenarios.expected: Cover all changed candidates, retain common body/comment evidence and uncertainty, produce supported findings and a concrete trial, and measure provider usage.
scenarios.observed: Both completed outputs classified exactly the same 35 candidates and selected the same five core sources from eight shared evidence packets. Both rejected an unsupported 95% claim, kept partial scan and comment limitations, and proposed a bounded same-quality trial. Two peripheral title-only categories differed; core recommendations did not. Materials: 71,483 vs 40,948 bytes. Actual input: 50,532 vs 39,527; output: 1,720 vs 1,561; cached input: zero for both. One pair only; shared selection, audit and release overhead is outside this model-stage comparison.

scenarios.request: Do a small saved-library increment without naming the skill, through an existing host entry rule.
scenarios.expected: Select the installed workflow and comparator, distinguish partial absence from deletion and unread bodies from reviewed evidence, and preserve fixture inputs.
scenarios.observed: A fresh agent selected Context Budget from the local rule, ran the installed source_delta.py once, recovered 1 addition, 1 not-seen item and 2 unchanged items, and read the relevant originals. It retained the unchanged title-only item as unread. Independent checksum recheck preserved all seven fixture input files. Synthetic fixture; not proof of every future session.

scenarios.request: Compare a partial scan with conflicting duplicate versions and recover complete pagination.
scenarios.expected: Reject conflicts and scope mismatches; preserve every relevant delta and input file.
scenarios.observed: Six current CLI tests passed, including duplicate conflict, scope mismatch, changed version/reference, full paging and read-only behavior.

scenarios.request: Use an existing reader and source comparator rather than recreate the research pipeline.
scenarios.expected: Check real installed interfaces and verify a representative slice.
scenarios.observed: The paired input preparation invoked all four pages of the installed comparator and selected eight source packets through the existing RedBot reader. Independent sets matched the entire 200-versus-200 snapshot scope; no parser, source fetcher or model provider was replaced.

scenarios.request: Answer a trivial wording question or infer subscription savings from a shorter payload.
scenarios.expected: Keep tiny work direct and keep bytes, model tokens, time and official quota separate.
scenarios.observed: Instruction walkthrough retains the direct route, disallows conversion of bytes into actual tokens or account quota, and requires wider task overhead and active-turn cutoffs to be disclosed.
